$ZEC is an extremely misunderstood asset, which is why there's still so much upside left.

ZEC started to bottom around April 2025, when @ebfull shared a blog post about Project Tachyon. Tachyon makes Zcash quantum proof and paves the way to scale Zcash to 50k TPS. And you cannot address quantum without addressing scalability since post-quantum cryptographic signatures are going to be an order of magnitude larger.

At the risk of sounding hyperbolic, the real bull case for Zcash is to fulfill Satoshi's vision: becoming peer-to-peer electronic digital cash. What many Bitcoiners gave up on. Zcash has the same properties as BTC, except it has a credible roadmap to scale to 50k TPS at the base layer, with built-in privacy. It's extremely ambitious, but that is the vision.

At the same time, I expect Bitcoin to undergo a crisis of confidence. Crypto participants have been conditioned to blindly believe BTC will hit new highs every couple of years. I believe these assumptions will be challenged as the quantum overhang looms large, and continued underperformance will drive more flows into ZEC. I would not be surprised if BTC trades like ETH last cycle.

Peter Thiel talks about the "Last Mover Advantage." That is, it's far better to make the last great development in a market and then dominate. Facebook vs Myspace. Google vs Yahoo. Zcash has dominated a small niche (privacy), and then it plans to scale to the ambitious goal, which is peer-to-peer electronic cash.

The ZEC trade closely resembles the SOL trade last cycle. ZEC's ability to move fast challenges a slow-moving incumbent (BTC), similar to how SOL challenged the ivory tower of ETH. History doesn't repeat, but it often rhymes.

There’s a fundamental mismatch between why Zcash is going up (Tachyon + last mover advantage) and the broader market’s understanding ("just a privacy coin"). Understanding this is a form of alpha/edge. I expect this knowledge gap to close when Tachyon hits mainnet in Q1 2027.

As a result, I expect the following over the next 1-2yrs:
1) Bitcoiners will start "silent quitting" and begin hedging their holdings with ZEC
2) Capital allocators that may have full ported BTC 5 years ago, will buy both ZEC and BTC as a bet on a sovereign SoV
3) Smart crypto developers to move on from other ecosystems to start contributing to Zcash
4) As ZEC continues to outperform BTC, people will start to seriously entertain the possibility of a flippening
5) $20,000 ZEC

Zigher.

re: the “communist/socialist” boogeyman in America

what’s interesting is you see a lot of Republican candidates pushing this messaging as a way to discredit Democratic challengers in races across the country (especially at the national level)

but it’s not really detracting from their appeal anymore. why?

the terms communism, socialism, etc. had much greater relevance to people in prior decades due to the Soviet threat. everyone associated communism with the USSR. and there was very little integration and trade between the US and USSR

but ofc, the USSR no longer exists. so what about China? aren’t they communist?

sort of, but to people sitting in the US, China actually comes across as hyper-capitalist (albeit authoritarian), especially on the global stage. i.e., people buy a ton of Chinese products (knowingly and unknowingly) and know that they are now maybe the greatest physically productive nation on the planet today

so the terms “communist” and “socialist” don’t have the same negative connotation they once had. we’re a full generation past the collapse of the USSR. and the one great power which is called “communist” seems to not be collapsing under its own weight

combine this with the specter of AI-related job losses and you can see why these ideologies are becoming more appealing to more people, especially when people can see that the government is increasingly corrupt and their cost of living is getting much worse relative to their wages

i don’t think socialism as it’s conceived of by organizations such as the DSA is the answer at all, but you’d have to be blind not to see that we need revisions to our economic model if it cannot sustain a thriving middle class of workers (especially in the face of greater destruction of that middle class through AI). even Elon seems to acknowledge this by talking about “universal high income”

the longer it takes us to start having these discussions, the more calamitous it will be once the boiling point is reached

anyway, don’t shoot the messenger…

Growing up in the United States, NYSE was synonymous with the story of American capitalism. I vividly remember learning about the Buttonwood agreement in 9th grade history class. 24 stockbrokers met under a tree on Wall Street and formed the beginning of what would become the world's financial center. From pits to computers to now onchain markets, America has always led the way in innovating markets to improve price discovery and capital formation. Today the next chapter begins with ICE, trade[XYZ], and Hyperliquid.

ICE started as an electricity-trading platform in 2000, growing to acquire NYSE itself in only 13 years. It is a key infrastructure provider of America’s energy, bond, and mortgage markets. ICE is a rare story of exponential growth of a financial giant over decades, continually embracing innovation and technology.

trade[XYZ] was the first HIP-3 deployer and responsible for spearheading the flourishing global RWA perpetual market today. Only a year ago, trade[XYZ] launched its first RWA perpetual markets. They took a bet on HIP-3, which had just launched after months of tireless development. Having followed their journey from day 1, I cannot overstate how much Shoku and the team have poured into growing these markets to a genuine source of price discovery for the most important assets in the world.

Over the past three years, Hyperliquid has pioneered onchain infrastructure to house all of finance. Hyperliquid is nothing without its world-class builders. I am honored that trade[XYZ] and ICE have chosen to build on Hyperliquid to bring perpetual contracts to America.

When I first spoke to Jeff Sprecher around a year ago, he asked what success looks like to me. I thought for some time and joked that it would be seeing ICE building on Hyperliquid's technology. I could never have predicted the progress that we've made as a community in a single year to make this come true. Excited to see what we can build together next.

I agree a lot with most of Zach's nuances on this, but I actually solved most of these problems with my Crime Score™️ that i'm building on my tool, allow me to explain:

Every score comes from a published investigation of an extraction operation: a rug, a bundled launch, an insider dump, a serial deployer. Every investigation is based on onchain evidence. No investigation, no score.

Why a wallet gets marked: the investigation shows it took part in the extraction. It deployed, bundled, sniped, dumped, funded the operation or collected the proceeds.

Never marked: victims, buyers who lost money, exchanges, DEXs, bots and other infrastructure, and early traders we can show acted on their own. Touching a rugged coin is not enough.

Side wallets: when we can prove one person or group controls several wallets, the record follows them across all of them.

What raises a score:
• Repeat offending. Each separate operation counts more than one big one.
• Role. Running the operation counts more than a supporting wallet.
• Serial launching. The more launches, the higher.
• Size of the extraction. from under $10K (least) up to $10M+ (most).
• Recency. Old cases fade, unless the operator is still launching. People are automatically forgiven for past Crime, unless they keep their bad behavior

One operation alone can't push a wallet to High or Very High unless it's a serial operation. The top of the scale is for repeat extractors.

team clearly knows who their target customers are and has shown that there is a clear demand for their product (discounted, cheap inference for new builders). much more work to do on both the demand and supply side imo, but so far so good

BUN was the first token launched this way and already has agents accumulating ETH from activity. Teams like Orbio are using it for their own agentic launchpads.

as agents market-make those pairs they accumulate more of the underlying token, which then further supports liquidity. This reflexivity flywheel compounds with every additional launch and becomes more obvious when on-chain liquidity conditions improve.
